description.value: Truffle Pigs Bistro & Lodge is a long-running mountain restaurant and lodge in Field, BC, situated in the heart of Yoho National Park and established in 2000. It evolved from a general store and café into a full bistro with twelve lodge rooms, known for passionate, locally inspired cooking and warm Rocky Mountain hospitality. The bistro offers an all-day menu with appetizers, burgers, and mains, and will prepare packed lunch kits for hikers and adventurers on request.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is richly populated and confirms the business is an active restaurant and lodge in Field, BC within Yoho National Park. The FAQ explicitly states lunch kits are prepared for hikers/adventurers ('Absolutely, and you don't even have to be a hiker'), and the bistro menu and FAQ both confirm vegetarian and gluten-free options. No bike parking, bike rack, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: Minor address spelling discrepancy: OSM uses 'Centre Street' while the website uses 'Center Street' — likely a Canadian/American English variant of the same address.
OSM opening_hours (Mo-Su 11:00-23:00) does not match website content, which states kitchen closes at 9pm and bar at 10pm — OSM hours appear outdated or inaccurate.
Wi-Fi is listed as a lodge room amenity ('Free WiFi') but it is not confirmed as available to bistro-only customers.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, year-round restaurant in a prime cycling corridor (Yoho National Park, between Lake Louise and Golden) with confirmed packed lunch service for adventurers and vegetarian/GF options — a clear benefit for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website email is displayed in reversed obfuscated form: 'moc.sgipelffurt@knio' decodes to oink@trufflepigs.com. The FAQ notes that all visitors to the area require a National Park Pass, which may be relevant context for directory users.

Packed lunches.detail: FAQ states: 'Do you prepare lunch kits for hikers? Absolutely, and you don't even have to be a hiker. We would be happy to get a lunch ready for you so you don't run out of steam on your daily adventure.'

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ states: 'We have select vegetarian and gluten free options on our menus.' Bistro menu also lists a vegan beet burger with 'vegan dill aioli'

wow_evidence: situated in the heart of Yoho National Park… established in 2000… lunch kits are prepared for hikers/adventurers, Absolutely, and you don't even have to be a hiker

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Appetizers $14–$20, visible mains ~$28; casual sit-down bistro
